personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean structure with 5 Brutalist Mobile oversized accessibility
personality_one_liner: A high-visibility, panic-proof utility interface designed for instant response and absolute clarity during high-stress driving situations.

spacing.rule: Use extremely generous spacing. Buttons must be massive (min 56pt height, SOS button should be 150-200pt). Avoid dense layouts.

do's: Use blur on bottom tab bar to allow map to bleed under
Use glass on sticky headers over scrolling alerts feed
dont's: Do not use blur on the SOS button or emergency sheets. They must be solid and high contrast.

screens.name: Início
screens.purpose: Provides instant access to the panic button and real-time location sharing.

states.loading: Centered spinner with 'Conectando à rede segura...' text.
states.error: Offline banner at the top, but SOS via SMS still enabled.

screens.layout: Massive circular #FF6B35 SOS button dominating the center/upper-middle. Below it, a bento box grid with oversized cards for 'Compartilhar Localização' (Real-time tracking link) and 'Contatos de Emergência'. Minimal text, huge touch targets.

screens.name: Mapa
screens.purpose: Collaborative risk map showing occurrences and safe zones.

states.error: GPS failure banner: 'Sinal de GPS fraco'.

screens.layout: Full-screen react-native-maps view. Search/Report FABs floating over the map. Bottom sheet to view nearby risk details or drop a new alert.

screens.name: Alertas
screens.purpose: Chronological feed of moderated incidents reported by other drivers.

states.empty: Calm street illustration + 'Nenhuma ocorrência grave reportada na sua região.'
states.error: Retry button + 'Não foi possível carregar os alertas.'

screens.layout: Sticky glassmorphic top header with horizontally scrolling category chips (Acidentes, Perigo, Polícia). Vertical list of large cards below. Each card uses high contrast colors based on threat level.

screens.name: Perfil
screens.purpose: Manage driver profile, emergency contacts, subscription plans, and privacy (LGPD).

states.error: Error loading user data with retry button.

screens.layout: Header with abstract texture cover and user initials/avatar. Vertical list of settings: 'Contatos de Emergência', 'Assinatura ROTA SEGURA (R$)', 'Privacidade e LGPD' toggles, and 'Painel Admin' (if role allows).

empty_state_alerts.alt: Rua vazia e calma sem alertas

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize accessibility: Use oversized touch targets, particularly on the Home screen. The SOS button should be the absolute focal point (min 150pt).
Adhere strictly to the requested visual identity: Navy Blue (#0B2545) and Orange (#FF6B35) on a Light White/Grey background.
Implement the SOS confirmation sheet using `@gorhom/bottom-sheet` to avoid accidental triggers, offering clear options to call 190/192/193 or message contacts.
Ensure all text is in Brazilian Portuguese (PT-BR) as requested.
Do NOT simulate fake alerts being sent to police. The SOS should only call the numbers or message configured contacts with explicit consent.
In the Alerts screen, use a gradient-to-dark scrim over the empty state image if it contains text overlay, to guarantee contrast.
